missingInputs.required: Verified geographic identity and EPSG:4326 Point [longitude,latitude], source identifier/hash/date and positional uncertainty. The tiny hero place is not identified from pixels alone.

License-cleared detailed GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in EPSG:4326, native vertex precision, scale/uncertainty, provenance and SHA-256. No screenshot tracing or synthetic coast accepted as measured geometry.

License-cleared ordered GeoJSON LineString in EPSG:4326 with real endpoints, direction, source/hash, uncertainty, and definition of the explained boundary. Arclength reveal follows the unmodified input ordering.
Explicit selection of the region to tint. COUNTRY_MAR is an available coarse candidate, not an independently approved target binding.
Explicit supplied geometry-ID to style-group mapping; no engine rule based on continent or nationality.

One coherent license-cleared basemap or evidence-backed source hierarchy covering the entire rotated camera envelope, with detailed local native pixels, dimensions, CRS/registration, extent, native resolution, parent SHA-256 and NoData. Upscaled global color pixels are not new source detail.

unverifiedClaims.required: Independent source, measurement definition, date and uncertainty if 85 m is to be stated as geographic fact. The video only supports reference-observed display text.
